description: This PHP source file defines the CloudWatchEvidentlyClient class, which extends the AwsClient base class to provide a client interface for interacting with the Amazon CloudWatch Evidently service. The class includes method annotations for various API operations related to creating, deleting, evaluating, and managing CloudWatch Evidently resources such as experiments, features, launches, projects, and segments.
